Daily Devotional

May 19

3 Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. (Philippians 2:3 KJV)

As Paul says here, we should never do things through strife or vainglory, which means we should never do things out of self-righteousness or pride (Proverbs 13:10). It is our human nature to be proud and self-centered creatures, and we really can’t do what Paul is telling us to do, unless we let Christ live through us. We must die to ourselves and let Christ live through us (Galatians 2:20). Only then can we truly behave like Christ did, and esteem others ahead of ourselves.

Since Jesus was God in the flesh (1 Timothy 3:16), and could still humble Himself, not only to serve others while on the earth, but to die for us (John 3:16), then we certainly can humble ourselves and put others ahead of our own selves. This demonstrates Jesus’ commandment, to love our neighbor as ourselves (Matthew 22:39). So we should all try to live the life of Christ, not to earn anything from God, but because we are Christians (little Christ’s), and it is the least we can do for Him that died for us (1 Peter 1:15). Make yourself a living sacrifice to God (Romans 12:1), and let your light shine out onto this dark world (Matthew 5:16).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
